tasks.gr9-understanding-development-hdi-t2: Topic: Understanding Development and HDI. Cover development indicators, Human Development Index components (life expectancy, education, income), and country rankings. Ask learners to interpret HDI data, compare countries, or explain what different HDI scores mean.
tasks.gr9-colonialism-trade-imbalances-t2: Topic: Colonialism and Trade Imbalances. Cover colonial legacies, economic dependency, and unequal trade patterns. Ask learners to explain colonial impacts, analyze trade imbalances, or discuss how countries break cycles of dependency.
tasks.gr9-sustainable-development-t2: Topic: Sustainable Development. Cover the three pillars (environmental, social, economic), sustainability challenges, and global goals. Ask learners to define sustainability, identify barriers, or propose solutions.
tasks.gr9-development-programmes-sa-t2: Topic: Development Programmes in South Africa. Cover education, infrastructure, social grants, healthcare, and job creation initiatives. Ask learners to describe specific programmes, evaluate their impact, or suggest improvements.
